main.description: The display half of a membership, in the member's own repo. If `org` is set the record key MUST be that org DID; otherwise (pure flair) it is a TID. Self-asserted — never authoritative for authorization.

org.description: The org's DID, when one exists. Absent means pure flair that nobody attests.

label.description: Display name. Authoritative for the name is at.tessera.org.profile.displayName when `org` is set.
